title: Liénard--Wiechert fields in AdS and flat-space antipodal matching from geodesic-centered Coulombic data
summary: We present a geometric derivation of Liénard--Wiechert fields in flat-space and AdS, emphasizing the origin of antipodal matching. In flat-space, the field of a uniformly moving charge is rewritten in coordinates centered on the source timelike geodesic. In this frame the charge is at rest and the solution is Coulombic, so the matching of the leading data at null infinity arises from describing a static field in a non-centered frame.
